thread:
Maya Patel: Quick recap from today's sync with Atlas. They want a Marketplace listing plus joint demo. Core asks: SSO (SAML primary, OIDC optional), SCIM provisioning, and HSM-backed KMS. Need alignment on docs, demo, and launch dates.
Jorge Ruiz: thanks — what's their preferred KMS flow? envelope keys with customer HSM or direct key import?
Maya Patel: Atlas prefers HSM-backed envelope keys (PKCS#11 module) + remote attestation for key residency proof. They asked for a staged launch: list availability now, HSM integration in a private beta.
Atlas Partner Bot: Atlas SAML metadata uploaded: https://atlas.partners/meta/prod.xml (valid 72h)
Tom Brooks: for Marketplace copy we need a small SAML snippet and the SCIM attribute map. Also any required disclaimers about key custody.
Lena Zhou: security note: we'll require attestation artifacts (quote, cert) and a documented verification step. Also add a threat-model checklist item for attestation and rotation. I'll kick off a quick review with sec-eval alias.
Jorge Ruiz: SAML snippet (to include in listing):
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://sso.atlas.example">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect" Location="https://sso.atlas.example/sso/redirect"/>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
SCIM attribute map example (for listing and docs):
```
scim.id -> id
scim.userName -> email
scim.name.givenName -> user.first_name
scim.name.familyName -> user.last_name
scim.active -> user.active
scim.emails[0].value -> user.primary_email
scim.groups -> user.group_ids
```
Maya Patel: good. For KMS we should document both: 1) customer-provided HSM (PKCS#11) with attest + rotation webhook, and 2) fallback: Atlas-hosted managed keys (if customer doesn't want to provide HSM). Listing should call out "HSM integration: private beta" when we don't have GA docs.
Tom Brooks: rotation webhook details?
Jorge Ruiz: rotation webhook endpoint will be: https://hooks.redwood.example/kms/atlas-rotation. Atlas must sign payloads with an HMAC token; we'll give them a test token. Webhook payload includes key_id, rotation_time, attestation_url. Example JSON:```json
{"key_id":"atlas-1234","rotation_time":"2026-05-06T18:32:00Z","attestation_url":"https://atlas.partners/attest/atlas-1234"}
```
Lena Zhou: require JWS signature on attestation artifacts and mutual TLS for the attestation endpoint. Add to security checklist.
Maya Patel: timeline check: Atlas marketing asked for listing + demo week of 5/12 and joint announcement by 5/14. Can we hit listing + SSO/SCIM + basic KMS docs by 5/12, and HSM attestation + rotation validation by 5/20?
Tom Brooks: engineering OK to deliver staged: listing + SAML/SCIM + demo script by 5/12. HSM end-to-end + attestation tests by 5/20 is realistic.
Jorge Ruiz: I'll create a short runbook with test cases: SSO login, SCIM provisioning (create user -> confirm RBAC), KMS rotate (simulate rotation webhook). Will post link.
Atlas Partner Bot: Atlas requests logo lock by 5/08 and final copy sign-off by 5/11.
Maya Patel: noted. Legal needs a snippet about customer-managed keys and residency. @Tom please add recommended legal text and I'll send to legal.
Tom Brooks: draft legal blurb for marketplace copy:
"Customers may provision and manage encryption keys via partner-provided HSMs. Redwood Inference does not persist customer private HSM keys; key material remains under customer control. See private deployment docs for configuration and compliance notes."
Lena Zhou: security will review that wording; also add a link to the attestation verification steps.
Maya Patel: action items: 1) Jorge -> runbook + SAML/SCIM snippets + webhook schema 2) Tom -> legal blurb + demo script + postman collection 3) Lena -> security checklist + attestation requirements 4) Maya -> partner comms, timeline, and marketplace submission.
Jorge Ruiz: will share runbook and test collection by EOD tomorrow.
Tom Brooks: I'll attach demo postman collection and sample slides before EOD. :thumbsup: 
Lena Zhou: I'll put the threat checklist in the shared drive and ping sec-eval.
Maya Patel: scheduling quick sync tomorrow 11am PT to finalize copy. Thanks all.
Atlas Partner Bot: Calendar invite: Atlas x Redwood - Launch prep - 2026-05-06 11:00 PT.
Maya Patel: perfect — that meeting will lock the final items for Marketplace and the beta plan.
